tests.argsPy:
vals, L, R = [], [], []
def node(v):
    vals.append(v)
    L.append(-1)
    R.append(-1)
    return len(vals) - 1
prev = -1
for k in range(1000):
    u = node(k // 2 if k % 2 == 0 else 1000 - k // 2)
    if prev >= 0:
        (R if (k - 1) % 2 == 0 else L)[prev] = u
    prev = u
out, q = [], [0]
for u in q:
    if u < 0:
        out.append(None)
        continue
    out.append(vals[u])
    q += [L[u], R[u]]
while out[-1] is None:
    out.pop()
args = [out]

vals, L, R = [], [], []
def node(v):
    vals.append(v)
    L.append(-1)
    R.append(-1)
    return len(vals) - 1
def balanced(lo, hi):
    if lo > hi:
        return -1
    mid = (lo + hi) // 2
    u = node(mid)
    L[u] = balanced(lo, mid - 1)
    R[u] = balanced(mid + 1, hi)
    return u
prev = -1
for i in range(991):
    u = node(10 * i)
    L[u] = balanced(10 * i - 9, 10 * i - 1)
    if prev >= 0:
        R[prev] = u
    prev = u
out, q = [], [0]
for u in q:
    if u < 0:
        out.append(None)
        continue
    out.append(vals[u])
    q += [L[u], R[u]]
while out[-1] is None:
    out.pop()
args = [out]

r = rng(98)
keys, seen = [], set()
while len(keys) < 10000:
    k = r.randint(-2**31, 2**31 - 1)
    if k not in seen:
        seen.add(k)
        keys.append(k)
vals, L, R = [keys[0]], [-1], [-1]
for k in keys[1:]:
    u = 0
    while True:
        side = L if k < vals[u] else R
        if side[u] < 0:
            vals.append(k)
            L.append(-1)
            R.append(-1)
            side[u] = len(vals) - 1
            break
        u = side[u]
out, q = [], [0]

        out.append(None)
        continue
    out.append(vals[u])
